page.notes: The large C is a woodcut initial showing a seated musician with a lute, inside an ornamental frame. The word beside it is not visible on this part, so it is marked as illegible. The title lines are copied as far as they show; the final letters of several words are not visible. "cator" at the start of the last line is doubtful. The top ornament is a woodcut border, not text. The woodcut Q initial and the ornamental border are part of the printed page; the border has no text. The left edge of every line is cut off on this scan, so the opening of the title and of several lines is missing; those words are marked as illegible or left as fragments. The reference "cap. 16. v. 26." stands at the left edge of the column in italic and is treated as a marginal note.
